# Libraries & Data

```{r}

# Key Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(nflfastR)
library(nflplotR)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
library(mgcv)

# Tracking Data
full_df <- read_csv("~/Documents/Sports Analytics/Personal Projects/NFL Field Value Model/full_data.csv")
```

# Completed Passes

```{r}

# Get completed passes from supplementary data
completed_passes <- full_df %>%
  filter(pass_result == "C") %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    # Play identifiers
    game_id, play_id,
    # Play context
    down, yards_to_go, absolute_yardline_number,
    # Play location
    play_direction, ball_land_x, ball_land_y,
    # Play value
    yards_gained, expected_points_added
    ) %>% 
  distinct()


```

# Visualize Plays

```{r}
# =========================================================
# 1. USER INPUT: Choose the game and play to visualize
# =========================================================
target_game_id <- 2023090700  # Set your desired game_id
target_play_id <- 461 # Set your desired play_id

# =========================================================
# 2. Filter & Standardize Coordinates
# =========================================================
play_data <- completed_passes %>% 
  filter(game_id == target_game_id, play_id == target_play_id) %>% 
  mutate(
    # Standardize Line of Scrimmage (LOS)
    los_x_std = if_else(play_direction == "left", 120 - absolute_yardline_number, absolute_yardline_number),
    
    # First Down Line (always offset to the right)
    first_down_x_std = los_x_std + yards_to_go,
    
    # Standardize Ball Landing Spot
    ball_land_x_std = if_else(play_direction == "left", 120 - ball_land_x, ball_land_x),
    ball_land_y_std = if_else(play_direction == "left", 53.3 - ball_land_y, ball_land_y)
  )

# =========================================================
# 3. Plot Field Layout & Pass Vector
# =========================================================
ggplot(play_data) +
  # --- Grass Turf & Endzones ---
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 120, ymin = 0, ymax = 53.3, fill = "#1e4620") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 10, ymin = 0, ymax = 53.3, fill = "#143016") +   # Left Endzone
  annotate("rect", xmin = 110, xmax = 120, ymin = 0, ymax = 53.3, fill = "#143016") +  # Right Endzone
  geom_vline(xintercept = seq(10, 110, by = 10), color = "white", alpha = 0.25, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(10, 110), color = "white", linewidth = 1) +              # Goal lines
  
  # --- Line of Scrimmage (Blue) & First Down Marker (Yellow) ---
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = los_x_std), color = "#4A90E2", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = first_down_x_std), color = "#F5A623", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  
  # --- Pass Trajectory Arrow (From LOS center to Landing Spot) ---
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = los_x_std, 
      y = 26.65, 
      xend = ball_land_x_std, 
      yend = ball_land_y_std
    ),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 1.2,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"), type = "closed")
  ) +
  
  # --- Catch / Landing Spot Marker ---
  geom_point(
    aes(x = ball_land_x_std, y = ball_land_y_std), 
    color = "#FF3333", size = 4, shape = 4, stroke = 2
  ) +
  
  # --- On-Field HUD / Play Statistics Text ---
  geom_label(
    aes(
      x = 60, y = 48,
      label = paste0(
        "Down: ", down, " & ", yards_to_go, 
        " | Yards Gained: ", yards_gained, 
        " | EPA: ", round(expected_points_added, 2)
      )
    ),
    fill = "#0f172a", color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 4
  ) +
  
  # --- Formatting & Dimensions ---
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = c(0, 120), ylim = c(0, 53.3)) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Pass Location Check — Game: ", target_game_id, " | Play: ", target_play_id),
    subtitle = "Blue Line = LOS | Yellow Line = 1st Down Line | Arrow = Throw Vector | Red X = Catch Spot",
    x = "Field Length (Yards)",
    y = "Field Width (Yards)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#0f172a", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#0f172a", color = NA),
    text = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "gray80"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "gray70", size = 10)
  )


```

# Field Value Model

```{r}

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Prepare Data & Compute Post-Play Expected Points
# ---------------------------------------------------------
completed_passes <- full_df %>%
  filter(pass_result == "C") %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    game_id, play_id, 
    los_x_std, ball_land_x_std, ball_land_y_std, 
    expected_points, expected_points_added
  ) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(
    # Compute Post-Play Expected Points
    post_ep = expected_points + expected_points_added,
    
    # Pass Depth relative to LOS
    pass_depth = ball_land_x_std - los_x_std
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    pass_depth >= -10 & pass_depth <= 45, 
    ball_land_y_std >= 0 & ball_land_y_std <= 53.3
  )

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1b. Apply Symmetry Mirroring
# ---------------------------------------------------------
completed_passes_sym <- bind_rows(
  completed_passes,
  completed_passes %>% mutate(ball_land_y_std = 53.3 - ball_land_y_std)
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Fit GAM with EP_pre as a Control Term
# ---------------------------------------------------------
gam_model <- gam(
  post_ep ~ te(pass_depth, ball_land_y_std, k = c(10, 10)) + s(expected_points, k = 20), 
  data = completed_passes_sym
)

summary(gam_model)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Create Continuous Surface Grid (0.5yd resolution)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
mean_pre_ep <- mean(completed_passes_sym$expected_points, na.rm = TRUE)

pred_grid <- expand.grid(
  pass_depth = seq(-10, 45, by = 0.5),
  ball_land_y_std = seq(1, 52.3, by = 0.5),
  expected_points = mean_pre_ep
)

# Predict Post-Play EP and convert to pure EPA Added
pred_grid$predicted_post_ep <- predict(gam_model, newdata = pred_grid)
pred_grid$predicted_epa     <- pred_grid$predicted_post_ep - mean_pre_ep

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Plot Continuous Field Value Surface
# ---------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(pred_grid, aes(x = pass_depth, y = ball_land_y_std)) +
  # Continuous interpolated surface
  geom_raster(aes(fill = predicted_epa), interpolate = TRUE) +
  
  # Value Contour Lines
  geom_contour(aes(z = predicted_epa), color = "white", alpha = 0.25, bins = 12) +
  
  # Line of Scrimmage Line (x = 0)
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#4A90E2", linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
  annotate("text", x = 1, y = 50, label = "Line of Scrimmage", color = "#4A90E2", fontface = "bold", hjust = 0) +
  
  # Midfield Hash Line (y = 26.65)
  geom_hline(yintercept = 26.65, color = "white", alpha = 0.3, linetype = "dotted") +
  
  # Diverging Color Palette (Blue = Below average, Slate = 0, Red = High EPA)
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#3B82F6", 
    mid = "#1E293B", 
    high = "#EF4444", 
    midpoint = 0, 
    name = "Expected EPA"
  ) +
  
  # Formatting & Styling
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Symmetric Passing Field Value Model (xEPA Surface)",
    subtitle = "2D Tensor Product GAM: Spatial Completion Value (Controlled for Pre-Play EP)",
    x = "Pass Depth relative to Line of Scrimmage (Yards)",
    y = "Field Width (Yards)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#0f172a", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#0f172a", color = NA),
    text = element_text(color = "white"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "gray80"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16)
  )

```
